scripts.migrate:up: rm -rf dist-migrations && tsc -p tsconfig.migrations.json --outDir dist-migrations/migrations && cp package.json dist-migrations/package.json && node-pg-migrate --esm -m dist-migrations/migrations up
scripts.migrate:down: rm -rf dist-migrations && tsc -p tsconfig.migrations.json --outDir dist-migrations/migrations && cp package.json dist-migrations/package.json && node-pg-migrate --esm -m dist-migrations/migrations down
